notes: run.py builds a repo per run from `fixture`, puts shims/glab on PATH, and runs `prompt` with `claude -p`. The session cannot write to the repo, so it must stop at the approval step. `findings_*` checks read outputs/mined/*-prs*.md. `calls_*` checks read outputs/glab-calls.log, one line for each glab call.

evals.name: review-history
evals.expected_output: Three findings, AppLogger first (3 MRs), then ViewModels without Android types (2 MRs, rule points to docs/architecture.md) and `when` over if-else (2 MRs, disputed in !105). The CHANGELOG reminder is in Seen once. No finding or entry for LGTM, the SonarQube bot, the off-by-one fix, or the author note. The session saves the state, shows the numbered list, and asks for approval. It writes nothing to the repo.
